description: Representation of the German transmission grid for Renewable Energy Sources impact analysis is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Mario Mureddu. This file is presented here as a zipped directory. The directory itself contains 5 other directories, one for each value of renewable energy penetration as described in the associated data descriptor. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2016. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 37161 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
